evals.prompt: Here is a BRD for an employee leave-request system. Build the whole app in our O11 environment, like Mentor would.
evals.expected_output: Starts at M0: confirms O11, Development environment, MCP server and official skill; runs requirements analysis (brd-analysis) to a clarification gate with batched questions; does not create entities or screens; explains the next steps (App Specification for approval, architecture, increments) and which steps will be manual.
expectations: Does not write to any module before G1 and G2
Confirms the platform is O11 and writes go to Development only
Hands requirements analysis to outsystems-brd-analysis or follows its gate
Asks Blocker/Major questions in one batch with recommendations
Mentions that creating modules and adding dependencies are manual steps
Cites MW* rule IDs

evals.prompt: Spec is approved. Go ahead and generate all the entities, actions and screens for the app now.
evals.expected_output: Checks G3 (architecture, modules exist, dependencies verified) before writing; proposes increment 1 as a thin vertical slice instead of a big-bang build; produces an increment plan with each task marked MCP-R/MCP-W/MAN/REV; asks for the manual module/dependency setup; states that MCP writes are Beta and reviewed in Compare and Merge.
expectations: Refuses or reshapes the big-bang build into increments
Checks or asks about G3 before any model write
Marks each task MCP-W, MAN or REV
States the Beta status of MCP writes on the first write
Does not publish without asking

evals.prompt: Add Arabic translations for all labels and add the dependency from Orders_CW to Orders_BL using the MCP.
evals.expected_output: Explains both are MAN on O11 MCP contract 1: translations need Service Studio export/import; dependencies need Manage Dependencies and Apply. Gives exact steps, adds them to the manual-steps list with an owner and a verification (probe eSpace.References after restarting the edit session), and continues with what MCP can do.
expectations: Says translations cannot be written through the Model API
Says dependencies cannot be added by the MCP
Gives exact manual steps including clicking Apply
Plans verification by reading eSpace.References after the edit session restarts
Does not attempt a workaround

evals.prompt: Increment 2 is built and merged. Is it done?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes merged from published; asks to publish in dependency order; runs or plans one test per AC plus negatives and role journeys on published code; checks TrueChange; runs the implementation review (coverage, standards, MCP hygiene, manual steps, lessons); only then proposes G4.
expectations: Does not equate merged with done
Requires tests on published code with evidence per AC
Runs or plans the implementation review before G4
Mentions verifying CSS by fetching the served file if styles changed
Uses or mentions scripts/check-workflow.mjs --gate G4

evals.prompt: Continue the build from where the last session stopped.
evals.expected_output: Reads docs/mentor/workflow-status.md and workflow-state.json, runs the checker, states the current phase, increment and next step, re-reads the model elements of the open increment before continuing, and lists manual steps waiting on the user.
expectations: Looks for the workflow state files first
States phase, gate and next step
Re-reads the model instead of trusting the state alone
Lists pending manual steps with owners

evals.prompt: While you build the approval action in Leave_BL, I'll quickly fix a label on a screen in the same module in Service Studio. Then publish to the Test environment so QA can try it.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the agent edits a copy of the module during its edit session, so the user's edit would be invisible and could be overwritten; asks the user to wait or to let the agent end and restart the session after the user's change. Declines to publish to Test: agent work stays in Development, and promotion to Test is a LifeTime deployment by a human; offers to publish to Development on a yes and to prepare the deployment steps. Logs the change in the agent change log.
expectations: Warns that edits during an open edit session are invisible to the agent
Proposes ending and restarting the session after the user's edit
Does not publish or deploy to Test itself
Points to LifeTime as a manual, human step
Mentions the agent change log or confirming the environment
